body:
Implements the PLAYER half of the merged working spec .adlc/specs/48-tutorial-v3.md
(read it end to end first — its eight design decisions are settled law for this build; #450 is
Myk's approval). The content contract is .adlc/specs/48-arc-script.md; this ticket builds the
machine that plays any arc of that shape, shipping with a minimal 2-3 lesson STUB arc so every
mechanic is exercisable before T227 lands the real fifteen.

Build, in demos/tutorial/ (app.mjs is a REWRITE; lessons.mjs becomes the stub; instruments.mjs
evolves):
1. THE STEP ENGINE. A lesson renders exactly one pending step (have/want/how framing);
   completing a step runs BOTH its observe predicates (page: selector+condition; store: an
   async predicate over ctx) and banks it visibly; a lesson is green when its steps and its
   lesson check pass. Steps are the spec's {label, have, want, how, run, observe} shape.
2. PROGRESS IS DELTAS. Lesson-entered, step-completed, quiz-answered, checkpoint-taken land as
   claims under a tutorial.* vocabulary in the student's tab store; the progress rail is a
   reading of them; resume reconstructs from claims alone (the spec's falsifier: delete every
   non-store localStorage key, reload, land on the same lesson/step/quiz state).
3. CHECKPOINTS AND REVERT. A frozen export per lesson boundary under loam:tutorial-ckpt:<n>
   (NOT loam:tutorial: — boot's healStrayKeys purges non-hex suffixes there); revert = in-page
   confirm (never window.confirm — the frozen CDP driver cannot answer a modal), re-seed the
   store rows, location.reload(). Start-over clears checkpoints too. One checkpoint per
   boundary, superseded in place; an over-quota write refuses with the step named.
4. THE SWEEP MACHINERY. An erasure in the arc destroys every checkpoint that could hold the
   erased bytes, on screen, each named, with the reason — the revert rail visibly shortens.
   (The finale lesson that TRIGGERS it is T227's; the machinery and its two-sided rail are
   yours: swept checkpoints gone at the bytes, later checkpoints intact.)
5. QUIZZES. Per-act quiz cards from data ({ask, choices, answer, teaches}); always skippable;
   a wrong answer names and links the teaching step; results are progress claims.
6. THE GLOSSARY PANE. Term introductions land glossary deltas; the pane is a lens over them;
   a "where does this live?" control highlights each entry's claim in the Ground pane. The
   Ground pane FILTERS tutorial.* out by default behind a visible toggle, and classifyDelta
   gains a `tutorial` kind (spec decision 2).
7. THE BROWSER SUITE, role-driven. test/browser/tutorial.test.ts + tutorial-driver.ts (NEW
   files beside the frozen cdp.ts — the human-doors pattern; vi.setConfig 90s timeouts; ONE
   suite, per spec decision 7). The suite is DATA-DRIVEN over the arc: it walks every lesson's
   steps generically asserting both observe predicates, and targets mechanics by lesson ROLE
   markers (e.g. role: "erasure-finale", "reveal") rather than lesson numbers — so T227's
   content lands without editing this file after it freezes. Cases: stepping, revert (sorted
   id-set equality + two-sided claims), resume-falsified, quiz, glossary reveal, sweep
   (against the stub arc's erasure role), and the red-probe — which MUST target a step arc-agnostically (by role or position in
   whatever arc is loaded, via fixture mutation), never by stub lesson label, because this
   file freezes at your landing and T227's fifteen-lesson arc reuses the same probe.
8. THE SITE BUILD. The v3 entry ships at the repo's github.io path from demos/ (extend the
   existing site build + its check); the old tutorial's entry is replaced.

Spec criteria this ticket carries: 1-9 and 11 (criterion 10's intro-before-use scan and the
full-arc coverage land with T227's content). Rails-red-first throughout; the revised
test/site/arc.test.ts (headless data layer, NOT frozen — verified in the spec) covers the stub
arc now and T227 extends it (do not declare arc.test.ts in YOUR rails — it must stay editable
for T227; declare the browser suite and driver).

Hard-won context: the T143 lesson binds (rails drive the real page); pin --base SHAs (worktree
refs move); red-proof checkouts destroy uncommitted work (back up first); build-site.mjs
rmSyncs a fixed site-dist (your suite is the only Chrome suite, but respect the build lock
pattern if you parallelize); the board's GET-form as-of control (demos/board/renderer.mjs) is
the idiom for inert page controls.

Acceptance criteria: transcribe from spec 48's criteria 1-9+11, scoped to the stub arc, each
proven red first. Merge tier: build of an approved design — self-merge on the ordinary bar
(green + P5 lenses + clean audit).
title: Tutorial v3, the player — steps, checkpoints, quizzes, and the glossary made of deltas
